findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the tests to pin that the earlier-showdown list stays reset after a table restart (violation/abandoned hand, new sit-and-go). Actual: the product behaves correctly, but the tests only check the very next hand after a restart, which gets [] regardless because the per-hand setup is rebuilt; deleting either restart-path reset of the carried list leaves all tests green while hands two or more after the restart would see stale pre-restart showdowns.
findings.fix: Strengthen the tests so a hand two or more hands after a violation restart, and after a new sit-and-go, is asserted to see only showdowns from hands since the restart.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Postflop-cap coverage for the 6-seat Tough line-up depends on the seed: with 2,000 hands, seeds 2024 and 8080 reach no capped postflop street (107 and 125 postflop bets/raises), while 42, 555, 1, 7, 99 and 31337 do. The spec's fixed seed 42 is fine; this is informational for future seed changes.
